annotations.text:
Token Watchroo · menubar app
Ring in the menubar = highest usage across agents. Click opens the panel. Each agent is tracked under one of two billing models: a subscription plan (individual or team) with session and weekly windows, or an API account (enterprise) with a monthly budget in dollars and tokens. Alerts fire once per window or budget at 80% and 95%, plus one on reset.
All numbers are sample values.
Leading direction: native macOS popover, one card per agent with a plan badge. Plan cards show windows, API cards show budget and today's spend. Tradeoff: quiet, but less glanceable than a gauge.
Alt A · Instrument cluster: dark, monospace, gauges plus a usage line. Tradeoff: dense, looks foreign next to system menus. Direction sketch only, still shows the plan-model data set.
Alt B · Big numbers: one large percentage per agent, serif display face, minimal bars. Tradeoff: fewest details visible, a budget in dollars fits less naturally. Direction sketch only.
Add agent sheet, both billing choices side by side. Plan agents need no budget; API agents get a monthly budget and read spend from the provider's usage API.
